agency: Florida Department of Environmental Protection, Oil and Gas Program
basis: issue date (the day the final permit was signed)
cadence: quarterly or as needed (the Department's words)
name: Florida
note: Permits counted by the date the Department signed them, from its own database, last saved September 8, 2026. Florida issues very few: the newest permit in the database was signed March 4, 2020, and months after it are zeros as the Department records them (applications still pending or denied carry no issue date and are not counted). A permit number with a letter (553A) is a modification of an earlier permit and counts as an amendment; the permit form records no well type, so injection and disposal permits cannot be told apart.
